source_metadata.title: Prevalence and significance of potential drug-drug interactions among cancer patients receiving chemotherapy

extraction_limitations: Additional Table 1 was referenced by the article but was not embedded in the retrieved PDF; no atoms were invented from it.
Background claims supported only by cited literature were not converted into primary-study result atoms.
Potential adverse outcomes in Table 5 are database-classified potential outcomes, not observed clinical adverse-event incidence in this cohort.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated field for DDI severity or documentation level; those source-reported classifications are preserved in canonical statements and tags for Table 5 rows.
